records.title: FlashVGGT: Efficient and Scalable Visual Geometry Transformers with Compressed Descriptor Attention
records.reason: FlashVGGT compresses descriptors for visual geometry attention and reports 10.1x speedup and 15.8x fewer FLOPs on 1,000 images, with lower memory. The result is 3D vision-specific and does not evaluate LLM inference.

records.title: UltraViCo: Breaking Extrapolation Limits in Video Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: UltraViCo targets longer video-diffusion sequences through model extrapolation/training, which the authors distinguish from inference-time modifications. It has a long-sequence connection but no direct LLM inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: V2-SAM: Marrying SAM2 with Multi-Prompt Experts for Cross-View Object Correspondence
records.reason: V2-SAM combines SAM2 with multi-prompt experts for cross-view object correspondence. The MoE wording is an application architecture for segmentation, not LLM MoE serving or inference optimization.

records.title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Local Attention in Transformers
records.reason: Theoretical analysis characterizes local-attention expressivity and long-range reasoning limits. It connects to sparse attention, but supplies no system-level latency/memory/throughput evaluation or deployable optimization.
